result.note: A brief state-politics item. The question tests the change of government in Kerala and the White Paper on state finances.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Kerala's new government formed in May 2026:
items: The Congress-led United Democratic Front's majority ended a decade of Left Democratic Front rule in the state.
The new government announced a special committee to draft a White Paper on the state's financial condition.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. The UDF ended ten years of LDF rule, and in May 2026 it set up a committee to prepare a White Paper on state finances. During the campaign, the UDF had repeatedly alleged that the LDF government had severely mismanaged Kerala's finances.
questions.source: Kerala’s new Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) government announced a special committee on Tuesday to draft a White Paper on the state’s financial condition.
